blocks.summary: Real-time WAM context scaling, autoregressive pretraining finding, and system overview.
Physical history vs latency dilemma, AR vs bidirectional pretraining, and core empirical results.
Positioning relative to WAMs, memory scaling, and real-time generative control.
LongLive2.0-Robot dataset composition, teacher-forcing sequence-parallel AR pretraining, and error recycling.
Causal-to-causal asymmetric coupling, IDM predict-then-act inference, and flow matching objectives.
Controlled sweep over 0 to 38.4 seconds of real physical observation history.
Pure asynchronous overlapping without trajectory blending, handoff deadline, and streaming VAE.
NVFP4 quantization, CUDA Graph, online softmax, and device-specific kernel tuning for RTX 5090, Spark, Thor.
Compute resources (64 H100s, 16 GB200s), AdamW hyperparameters, and robot platforms.
Evaluation on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, DOMINO, and RoboCasa GR-1.
Context scaling peak analysis, AR vs bidirectional divergence, and IDM vs CoD vs w/o V.
RoboCasa365 atomic skill execution and GPT-6 Astra composition on unseen tasks.
Dynamic conveyor grasping and cup stacking on Unitree G1, long-horizon manipulation on YAM.
RTX 5090 107.4 ms latency, pure async smoothness, and cumulative 3.2-4.1x speedup decomposition.
59 scholarly bibliographic citations.
Discussion, division of labor between planning and execution, and adaptive context horizon.
Pretraining data breakdown (Table 9), teacher-forcing error recycling formulation, and cache scope.
Qualitative video generation rollouts with LongLive2.0-Robot (Figure 9).
Detailed citations and configurations for policy and WAM baselines.
RoboTwin 2.0 overlap length sweep (Table 10), overlap RMSE, Jerk proxy, and decision frequency trade-off.
IDM vs CoD latency protocol (Table 11), compute rates, and observed-video KV reuse speedups.
Latency vs context length on RTX 5090 (Table 12).
Additional real-world deployment rollouts for G1 and YAM (Figures 10-16).

glossary.note: Unified foundation model linking visual dynamics prediction with robot action execution.
Predict-then-act inference: first predicts future latents, then conditions action denoising on both history and predicted futures.

glossary.translation: 协同去噪 / 联合去噪
glossary.note: Joint bidirectional denoising of future video and action tokens across steps.
Incremental visual encoding overlapping observation chunks with robot execution to avoid trigger stalls.
Model inference fully overlapped with robot movement without trajectory blending or test-time guidance.
Native 4-bit floating point weight and activation quantization on NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.
Numerically stable cross-segment attention fusion without physical tensor concatenation of video and action KV.
